title: AI Image Studio
description: Choose a finished look, change a few details, and generate.

gallery.description: Choose the result you want first. The template handles the prompt and art direction.

generator.description: Fill the essentials below. The full visual prompt is already built in.
generator.customizeHint: Only change what matters for this result.
generator.referenceRequired: This transformation needs a source image. Close the studio, select an image on the Board, then open Edit image.

templateMeta.selectImageFirst: Select an image on the Board before generating

subject.placeholder: What should the image be about?

scene.label: Scene
scene.placeholder: Where should it happen, and what should the mood be?

details.placeholder: Add only the details that must appear or stay unchanged.

palette.label: Colors
palette.placeholder: Optional, for example: warm cream, forest green, and gold

surreal-city-poster.name: Surreal city poster
surreal-city-poster.description: Turn a place or idea into a collectible editorial travel poster.

placeholders.subject: For example: a dreamlike future Hangzhou
placeholders.scene: Iconic buildings, winding sky roads, tea fields, tiny travelers…
placeholders.palette: Muted jade, warm stone, mist blue

miniature-product-campaign.name: Miniature product campaign
miniature-product-campaign.description: Build a six-panel commercial story around one hero product.

placeholders.subject: For example: a sparkling lemon drink called Limora
placeholders.scene: A sunny beach where tiny people interact with giant ingredients

engineering-infographic.name: Engineering infographic
engineering-infographic.description: Explain a complex product with cutaways, data, and technical callouts.

placeholders.subject: For example: a next-generation electric city bus
placeholders.details: Battery system, dimensions, charging workflow, environmental impact…

landmark-type-poster.name: Landmark type poster
landmark-type-poster.description: Make a city name from its most recognizable landmarks and details.

placeholders.subject: For example: Shanghai
placeholders.details: The Bund, plane trees, ferries, lane houses, skyline…

brand-touchpoint-board.name: Brand touchpoint board
brand-touchpoint-board.description: See a full brand system across packaging, products, and lifestyle scenes.

placeholders.subject: For example: a modern matcha brand called Matcha Mode
placeholders.details: Ceramic cup, takeaway packaging, menu, tote bag, stickers…

neon-creator-poster.name: Neon creator poster
neon-creator-poster.description: Create a bold 3D personal or professional identity poster.

placeholders.subject: For example: a confident motion designer
placeholders.details: Oversized streetwear, camera, laptop, 3D tools, mini figure…

vintage-travel-poster.name: Vintage travel poster
vintage-travel-poster.description: Turn a destination into an aged cinematic print with iconic depth.

placeholders.subject: For example: Guangzhou at golden hour
placeholders.details: Canton Tower, arcade streets, river ferry, kapok flowers…
placeholders.palette: Warm amber, cobalt blue, faded sepia

product-concept-board.name: Product concept board
product-concept-board.description: Present the design journey from inspiration to a finished product.

placeholders.subject: For example: a chair inspired by crumpled paper
placeholders.details: Form analysis, ergonomics, materials, dimensions, prototype…

vocabulary-learning-card.name: Vocabulary learning card
vocabulary-learning-card.description: Teach a whole object and one related part in a friendly visual card.

placeholders.subject: For example: corn and kernel
placeholders.details: Use short uppercase labels for the whole and its part
placeholders.palette: Pastel blue, white, natural object colors

editorial-silhouette-poster.name: Editorial silhouette poster
editorial-silhouette-poster.description: Combine a bold side-profile portrait with expressive type and raw ink.

placeholders.subject: For example: an avant-garde fashion designer in side profile
placeholders.details: Bob haircut, angular sunglasses, raw brush lettering…
placeholders.palette: Black ink on warm off-white paper

mixed-media-memory-card.name: Mixed-media memory card
mixed-media-memory-card.description: Keep half of a photo intact and redraw the memory below by hand.

placeholders.details: What moment or small detail should the sketch emphasize?
placeholders.palette: Muted colors sampled from the photo

travel-field-notes.name: Travel field notes
travel-field-notes.description: Pair an authentic travel photo with a handmade location stamp.

placeholders.details: Location name and the few landmarks the stamp must preserve
placeholders.palette: 2–4 muted spot colors sampled from the photo

paper-collage-portrait.name: Paper-collage portrait
paper-collage-portrait.description: Keep the person realistic and rebuild the world as layered paper art.

placeholders.scene: For example: a spring garden with hills, clouds, and flowers
placeholders.details: Identity, outfit, and pose details that must stay unchanged
placeholders.palette: Dreamy pastels with natural skin tones

photo-doodle-mix.name: Photo with doodle people
photo-doodle-mix.description: Keep the real background and redraw only the people as playful doodles.

placeholders.details: Which people to transform and what identity details to retain
placeholders.palette: Black ink with restrained hand-colored accents

doodle-character.name: Doodle character
doodle-character.description: Turn a portrait into a loose, charming fashion-notebook character.

placeholders.details: Hairstyle, clothing, accessories, and features to preserve
placeholders.palette: Black pencil with soft blush and light crayon color

character-production-sheet.name: Character production sheet
character-production-sheet.description: Expand one character into consistent views, poses, and material callouts.

placeholders.details: Signature equipment, materials, views, poses, and expressions
placeholders.palette: Main neutrals plus one signature accent color
